cases.situation: My mother-in-law said 'must be nice to order takeout every night' while visiting. It's a one-off dig and I don't want a thing.
cases.reply: Ha, it's been a hectic month! Actually, would you show me your chicken soup next time you're over? Luca still talks about it.
cases.note: Face value denies the dig any oxygen, and the question is genuine, not flattery.

cases.situation: 室友在群里说“我就自己倒垃圾吧，反正也没人管”。确实最近几次都是她倒的。
cases.reply: 听起来你是烦我最近没倒垃圾，这确实是我的问题。我现在就去倒。以后我们排个表，一人一周，你看行吗？
cases.note: 她的不满有道理时，处理内容，不纠结语气。

cases.situation: Since I got engaged, my best friend keeps making little digs ('some of us still pay rent alone'). I asked once and she said she's fine. It just happened again.
cases.reply: This is the second time I've asked and got a sharp reply, so I'm not going to keep guessing. If something about the engagement is hard for you, I'd honestly rather hear it straight. Whenever you want to talk, I'm here, and until then I'll take things at face value.
cases.note: Second time, name the pattern and hand her the choice. Then really do take messages at face value.

cases.situation: 部门工作群里，同事老周发了一句“有些人的周报还是没交啊，大家都等着汇总呢”，明显是说我。确实晚了一天，因为在等财务那边的数据。
cases.reply: 是我这份，财务的数据昨天下午才给到，我今天中午12点前发到群里。晚了一天，耽误大家汇总了，不好意思。
cases.note: The dig has a real complaint inside it, so answer the contents with a time; do not comment on his tone in front of the group.

cases.situation: My sister texted 'Don't worry, I'll host Thanksgiving AGAIN, it's fine, someone has to.' She's hosted three years running and I did say I'd take a turn. I'd rather not do this over text.
cases.reply: That sounds like it's not fine, and fair enough: you've hosted three years in a row and I said I'd take a turn. Can I call you tonight after 8? I'd like to sort out this year properly, and I'm happy for it to be at mine.
cases.note: The dig wraps a legitimate point, so own it and move to a call; over text this one turns into a fight.

cases.situation: Freelance designer. Client Mark emailed 'As I've already said twice, the logo needs to be bigger. Not sure how else to put it.' I did make it bigger in v2 and he approved v2 on Friday. Now we're on v3.
cases.reply: Hi Mark, understood, you'd like the logo bigger than it is in v3. So I get it right this round: should it fill about a third of the header width, or closer to half? I'll send the revised version by 3pm tomorrow, Wednesday.
cases.note: Answer the request, not the tone, and turn a vague 'bigger' into a choice so there is no v4. Raise the v2 approval only if extra rounds become a billing question.
